newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Furman Selz raises Forest.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Furman Selz raises Forest.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said analysts James Flynn and Frederick Clark raised their rating on Forest Laboratories Inc to buy from neutral with a 12-month price target of $45. The stock was placed on the firm's recommended list.
-- The analysts said a selloff on Wednesday provided "a prime buying opportunity" because the company's "disappointments" were now in the past.
-- The stock on Wednesday dropped 9-3/8 to 29-3/8 after the company said it expected operating losses for the next two quarters and for fiscal 1997.
-- The stock rebounded 1-1/8 to 30-5/8 in Thursday afternoon trading on the American Stock Exchange.
